FIELDS.NAME: Heritage Library & Museum
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, 123 Heritage Lane, Springfield, IL 62704-5678, (555) 123-4567, jsmith@heritagelibrary.org
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Heritage Library & Museum operates as a community-focused institution dedicated to preserving and showcasing local history and culture. Our primary operations include the curation and preservation of collections, which encompass books, documents, artifacts, and artworks significant to the heritage of our community. We provide a welcoming atmosphere for visitors through exhibits, educational programs, workshops, and events aimed at engaging the public with our collections and resources. The library services include access to digital and physical media, research assistance, and literacy programs designed for all age groups. To ensure the safety and integrity of our collections, we have implemented security measures, such as locked display cases and alarm systems, and maintain standard climate control to protect sensitive materials. Our staff is trained in collection care and emergency procedures, allowing us to provide a secure environment for both visitors and our priceless resources. Additionally, we conduct periodic maintenance on our facilities to ensure compliance with safety regulations and continue upgrading our security and climate control systems as needed.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Heritage Historical Society, Springfield, IL - Non-profit organization focused on historical preservation and community events.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: The Heritage Library & Museum experienced a theft on March 15, 2023, where several rare artifacts valued at $3,000 were stolen during operating hours. The incident has been reported to the local police and the artifacts have not been recovered. The status of this loss is currently pending investigation. Additionally, on June 5, 2023, water damage occurred in the archives due to a leaking roof, resulting in a loss of $2,000 for restoration efforts. This damage has been fixed and the facility is now compliant with necessary repairs.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 5 PM; Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 3, Grade B, Secure Vault with Biometric Access System
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Basic security measures in place, including alarm systems and periodic inspections by trained staff.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost of collections and artifacts
